comment: World (v) of the families round, light and charge (HIGHLIGHTS.md, Every family run on the engine and seen to work; the advisor's blinds, #1563 comment 5928483084; ALGEBRA.md rows (b), (f), (p), The content's index for every family, items 15 and 16): a packet of light, the holder of the sign's own record, along a tube past a body, its arrival on a screen the one measurement. The tube: x open with the faces' layer one Node deep and both x faces receding (`receding`, the source's return and what passes the screen leave the declared board), y and z periodic at `across` Nodes; the body at `centre`; one message of the charge family along +x at the wave number pi `wave`[0] / `wave`[1] per Link, the level `amplitude` at its top, the top the column x = `top` over the whole cross-section with a raised cosine of `edge` Nodes along x (the packet's own form sources the binding holder at the level weight 1, so its amplitude is kept under the two slits' 1,328: at 200 the lay's share rounds to no quantum at any Node and the count reads 0, at 600 about one quantum per Node of the top, the packet's own well a few hundred levels at the slab's centre, which slows the packet by its own index alike in the three worlds); the screen the column x = `screen` in `across` / `rows` regions of `rows` rows each across y and the whole ring across z (`screen_0` to `screen_3`, ordered along y; the loader's size rule, at least half the wavelength, q / p = 4 Nodes, across the beam on every axis of more than one Node, refuses a region of one row), backed by the receding face. Three worlds on the universe of world (iv), examples/events/charge/charged.json (the rule's rows with the charged family): `free`, no body, the arrival's reference; `through_neutral`, a compact pixel of the matter family of `quanta` quanta at the centre; `through_charged`, the same quanta of the charged family laid rotating in the sense +1 (the fence of its lay as in examples/events/charge/design.json). Light reads every holder of the content (gravity and the binding holder) and none of its own row: the body's content delays the packet by the index of The content's index for every family, 1 / (1 - 2 U) for light at every k, and the holder of the sign's level about the charged body enters no pace of light, so the charged and the neutral worlds read alike to the rounding, the 0 of a first-order force of the sign on light (row (f): no bending of light by a static charge). The Peierls phase of the odd line at the wall den T, lambda = W_c / (den T) = 3 = 1 / c^2, acts on the two-part record alone and is not read here; the magnetic force F_C / gamma and the Lorentz identity under the rotation with the odd line at the wall (items 15, 16) are the rotation round's blinds at its declared world, examples/events/parallel_charges/, to be run when the generator lays a moving body. The worlds are laid by the builder with --modes on the finished engine (on main 3fe40aeb's engine the free world laid 2,304 quanta of light at the amplitude 600; no world laid on the old engine is committed). Headless, `ticks` intervals; the reading by tools/click_counts.py against the blind, the clicks' arrival first (DETECTOR), and tools/body_rest.py for the body. The run is not performed in the round that prepares it.
